items.label: U.S. Representative
items.text: Sworn in on June 10, 2026 as U.S. Representative for California's 1st District after winning the June 2, 2026 special primary outright, to complete the term of the late Rep. Doug LaMalfa. (sources: Office of Rep. James Gallagher (house.gov) https://gallagher.house.gov/media/press-releases/taking-oath-office [search summary, primary]; Roll Call https://rollcall.com/2026/06/10/james-gallagher-sworn-in-to-finish-lamalfas-term-in-the-house/ [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia News https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/06/15/james-gallagher-takes-office-ending-the-vacancy-in-californias-1st-congressional-district/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: California State Assembly
items.text: Member of the California State Assembly from 2014 to 2026; served as Assembly Republican Leader (Minority Leader), 2022 to 2025. (sources: Office of Rep. James Gallagher (house.gov) https://gallagher.house.gov/biography [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Gallagher_(California_politician) [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Sutter County Board of Supervisors
items.text: Member of the Sutter County Board of Supervisors, 2009 to 2014 per the House history office entry. (sources: U.S. House of Representatives, History, Art & Archives https://history.house.gov/People/Detail/36507229550 [search summary, primary]; Office of Rep. James Gallagher (house.gov) https://gallagher.house.gov/biography [search summary, primary])

items.label: Education
items.text: B.A., University of California, Berkeley, 2003; J.D., University of California, Davis School of Law, 2007. (sources: Office of Rep. James Gallagher (house.gov) https://gallagher.house.gov/biography [search summary, primary]; U.S. House of Representatives, History, Art & Archives https://history.house.gov/People/Detail/36507229550 [search summary, primary]; UC Davis School of Law https://facultyblog.law.ucdavis.edu/news/james-gallagher-07-elected-congress [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Career
items.text: Attorney practicing agricultural law and partner in his family's farming business in Sutter County. (sources: Office of Rep. James Gallagher (house.gov) https://gallagher.house.gov/biography [search summary, primary])

items.text: Born in 1981. (sources: Office of Rep. James Gallagher (house.gov) https://gallagher.house.gov/biography [search summary, primary]; U.S. House of Representatives, History, Art & Archives https://history.house.gov/People/Detail/36507229550 [search summary, primary])

items.label: California State Senate
items.text: Elected to the California State Senate (District 2) in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022; Senate Majority Leader from 2022; President pro Tempore of the Senate from February 5, 2024 to November 17, 2025. (sources: California State Senate, Senator Mike McGuire https://sd02.senate.ca.gov/node/25 [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_McGuire_(politician) [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Local offices
items.text: Member of the Healdsburg school board; member of the Healdsburg City Council from 2004, including service as mayor; member of the Sonoma County Board of Supervisors (4th District), elected 2010, serving 2011 to 2014. (sources: JoinCalifornia https://www.joincalifornia.com/candidate/14091 [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_McGuire_(politician) [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: B.A., political science, Sonoma State University, 2002. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_McGuire_(politician) [search summary, secondary]; Sonoma State University https://stratcomm.sonoma.edu/node/286 [search summary, secondary])
